goal.text: Give a small team one boring, verifiable way to ship.
metrics: A change reaches production in under a day
No release needs a manual checklist

deliverables.text: An ingest pipeline with a replayable dead-letter queue

useCases.text: creates and activates an account without support
replays a failed batch without touching the database

functional.text: A customer can verify their email address
A failed batch can be replayed from the dead-letter queue
An operator can see why a batch failed

nonFunctional.text: The onboarding API stays responsive under load
No personal data appears in logs

risks.text: The auth vendor's free tier may not cover launch volume
risks.mitigation: Price the paid tier before the beta

risks.text: Assumes the legacy export format never changes

gaps.text: The plan says nothing about how a customer deletes their account
No stated retention period for ingest artefacts

openQuestions.text: Who owns the customer-support escalation path?
